_comment: Every downloadable document and external link the site offers, grouped by section. href values that start with http are used as-is; everything else resolves against docBase. Today docBase points at the legacy tahoebmp.org file store; to move the files onto tools.trpa.gov, copy them into a documents/ folder in this repo with the same relative paths and set docBase to 'documents/'. type drives the icon and the (PDF) style suffix: pdf, doc, xlsx, dwg, video, link, page. Sections follow the program's Oct. 2026 review: installation, training, maintenance, forms, landscaping, policy.
